title: Omega Codex Minimal Derivation Chain and Cosmos Roadmap DAG
description: Directed acyclic graph classifying every node in the Omega Codex program into DERIVED (checked in Lean 4.33.0 or stdlib Python with source-bound receipts), OWED (explicit host admissions, supplied premises, unfreezing choices, and open bridge obligations), and IMAGINED (downstream WDP, L1/L2, finite quantum, gauge, gravity, and self-hosting metatheory targets still to come).

claim_hygiene_scope.supports: A deterministic, machine-auditable inventory of which derivation nodes are checked by Lean 4.33.0 and stdlib Python in this repository (DERIVED), which premises or bridge steps remain supplied admissions or open proof obligations (OWED), and which downstream mathematical or physical stages are planned future targets (IMAGINED).
claim_hygiene_scope.does_not_support: Any claim that OWED or IMAGINED nodes are derived, any claim of zero-input creation from nothing, or any physical validation beyond the finite algebraic models checked in the cited files.
claim_hygiene_scope.narrowest_defensible_claim: All nodes in bucket DERIVED resolve to existing Lean 4.33.0 theorems (checked under allowed axioms propext and Quot.sound) and/or stdlib Python check scripts in this checkout, and all dependencies on OWED premises are explicitly typed as edges in the acyclic graph.
claim_hygiene_scope.next_test_needed: Constructive discharge or minimal-premise reduction of the OWED bridge nodes, starting with OWE-07 (internal witnessing invocation), OWE-08 (endogenous sheet-flip holonomy forcing and n = 10 vs. minimal n = 3 stick carrier selection), OWE-09 (cross-orbit weight ratio selection on non-transitive quotients), and OWE-13 (endogenous non-supplied rule acquisition and repair persistence).

DERIVED.definition: Checked in Lean 4.33.0 (constructive core, zero sorry, zero Classical.choice, zero Mathlib, allowed axioms restricted to propext and Quot.sound) and/or stdlib Python check scripts with source-bound verification receipts in docs/.

OWED.definition: Explicitly priced host substrate admissions (S0-S5), unfreezing mechanism choices (M1-M3), and open bridge obligations where a claim in the historical or target chain requires a premise not forced by prior derived nodes alone.

IMAGINED.definition: Planned downstream extensions still to come: higher semi-simplicial WDP complexes, observer presheaf cohomology, L1-to-L2 complex phase amplitude bridge, finite quantum mechanics (Born/Gleason/CPTP/MUB), finite gauge sectors, simplicial Regge gravity, constructor theory, and self-hosting Cosmos metatheory.

nodes.title: Constructive Type-Theoretic Host Substrate (S0)
nodes.statement: The dependent type theory of Lean 4.33.0 (types, functions, inductive types, equality, quotients, propext, and Quot.sound) is supplied by the formal host environment and is not derived from empty nothingness.

nodes.title: Inhabited Off-Diagonal Mark Witness (S1)
nodes.statement: To instantiate a concrete mark, one must supply a type alpha, a binary relation R, and an inhabited off-diagonal witness (a, b) with R a b and a != b. An empty or singleton carrier admits no such witness.

nodes.title: Symmetry Extension, Composition Law, Retention Axis, and Cost Target Admissions (S2-S5)
nodes.statement: Extending directed difference D2 to symmetric apartness S2 (S2), equipping endomorphisms with composition (S3), adding a state retention bit (S4), and pricing arity or cochain defects via an additive norm (S5) are explicit structural admissions.

nodes.title: Post-Seal Unfreezing Mechanisms: Multiplicity, Indexed Family, or Dynamics (M1-M3)
nodes.statement: Because S2Bool has exactly two elements and C2 has one non-identity involution, any post-seal growth beyond cardinality 2 requires choosing at least one unfreezing mechanism: carrier multiplicity |alpha| >= 3 (M1), an indexed family of regimes/contexts (M2), or an external step/history index (M3).

nodes.title: Primitive Difference, Soundness Equivalence, and Two-Slot Counterpart Involution
nodes.statement: Global pairwise soundness of a relation R (every related pair is non-identical) is equivalent to irreflexivity of R; a local off-diagonal pair does not force global irreflexivity on larger carriers; on Bool, S2 is irreflexive, symmetric, and complete off-diagonal with unique counterpart involution.

nodes.title: Two-Position Relation Census, C2 Torsor Displacement, and Closure/Merger Algebra
nodes.statement: Among the 16 binary relations on Bool, 4 are irreflexive (empty, D2, D2rev, S2Bool); D2 has trivial automorphism group while S2Bool has automorphism group C2 = {id, flip} acting freely and transitively as a C2-torsor; idempotent closure and diagonal merger collapse difference.

nodes.title: Root-to-Two-Point Carrier Bounds, List-Length Radix Bound, and Symmetry Floor (OQ-01 / RT-03 / N16)
nodes.statement: No subsingleton image admits an irreflexive witness; indexed pair admission requires distinct indices i != j; any list-expansion step [t] ++ next with [t].length = 1 requires next != [] to reach length >= 2 (OQ-01 / RT-03); under swap-equivariance on Bool, any non-empty irreflexive relation equals S2Bool, no single off-diagonal pair is swap-fixed, and on Fin 3 deterministic equivariant choice collapses to the fixed point 0 whereas invariant multi-element offers retain the 2-orbit {1, 2} (N16).

nodes.title: Mirror Non-Identification and Internal-vs-External Asymmetry
nodes.statement: Under swap-equivariant access on S2Bool, internal observation-only procedures give identical outputs on both slots, whereas external referent-indexed identity queries distinguish them; symmetry-preserving multi-element offers avoid single-choice collapse on Fin 3.

nodes.title: Kernel Zero-Equivalence, Residual Quotient Factorization, and Boundary Non-Determination
nodes.statement: Every observation kernel K : alpha -> beta induces an equivalence relation zeroRel; the canonical map factors injectively through ResidualQuotient K; collapse to a subsingleton quotient holds iff all pairs are zero-related; static kernel equivalence does not determine terminal behavior under admissible extensions.

nodes.title: Pruned 4-Tuple Regime4, Mention Irrelevance, Permutation Invariance, and Kernel Bridge
nodes.statement: Separability in the 6-tuple WDP regime is independent of rule lists and mention tags, reducing faithfully to the 4-tuple Regime4 = (items, forms, insts, eval); collapsed4 coincides with the joint ZeroEquivalence.Kernel over all instantiated forms; Delta-extensions preserve prior separability and are invariant under item/form bijections.

nodes.title: Unary Separator Uniqueness at Cost 2 and Zero-Unary-Weight Three-Item Countermodel (OQ-04 / RT-01)
nodes.statement: For any arity weight phi : Nat -> Nat with phi(1) >= 1 and phi(1) < phi(k) for all k >= 2, no response list of total cost <= 1 separates (0, 1) from R2L4, and among 2-item responses [a, b] (mu1 = 2) with phiSum4 phi [a, b] <= phi(1), the unary separator U0_4 (and U0F_4) is unique up to regime isomorphism (OQ-04); if phi(1) = 0 is allowed without fixing response length to 2, the 3-item response [newForm 1, newForm 1, newInst 0 [0]] separates (0, 1) on R2L4 at phiSum4 = 0 with 2 forms instead of 1 (RT-01).

nodes.title: Quotient-Refinement Round Bound and Explicit-vs-Derived Accounting Gap (OQ-05 / RT-09)
nodes.statement: On a fixed finite carrier of size n (r.data = n fixed), any QuotRefRun sequence whose transitions satisfy per-step class-count growth c + 1 <= c' satisfies c0 + m <= n and m <= n - 1 when 1 <= c0 (quotient_refinement_bound, quotient_refinement_from_one), strictly below the explicit pair-demand bound n*(n - 1)/2 for n >= 3 (explicit_pair_round_bound, strict_gap_for_n_ge_3). Includes an n = 3 fresh-form existence witness (rt09_fresh_form_strictly_refines_all_pairs) and preserves the existing-form re-collapse counterexample (rt09_unrequested_pair_recollapse_witness) where appending an instance of an existing form can re-collapse an unrequested pair; connected to general Regime4 transitions by DER-24.

nodes.title: Five-Mode Refusal Hierarchy and Tagged vs Untagged Reification
nodes.statement: On duplicate inputs, silent refusal and external meta-markers leave data state unchanged; fact-bit recording mutates state without growing the item carrier; untagged and tagged reification grow the carrier by 1 while the tag bit separates their outputs.

nodes.title: Exact 16/1024 Two-Step Retaining Laws, 4/1024 Drift-Free Law, and Multi-Step Idle Drift (OQ-03 / RT-02)
nodes.statement: Out of 2^10 = 1024 truth tables for (x', m') = F(x, m, e), 16 satisfy two-step retention (8 state updates x 2 output readouts), and 4 satisfy idle drift-freeness and slot symmetry; a law in the 16\4 slice that flips m on idle steps loses retention at 2 idle steps, whereas drift-free laws preserve memory across arbitrary idle horizons k >= 0.

nodes.title: Choice-Free Finite Report Decoding, Image Invariance, and Global-vs-Finite Congruence (OQ-06 / RT-05 / RT-10)
nodes.statement: Over any finite history list H : List Hist with DecidableEq V, state factors through report on H iff state is constant on report-fibers, realized constructively by first-match lookup decodeFin without Classical.choice (OQ-06); on the report image of H, decodeFin is invariant under list reordering/duplication and fallback default changes, while off-image queries return defaultS (RT-10); global UnaryCongruent S phi is equivalent to fiber constancy across all finite lists D : List alpha, whereas fiber constancy on a single fixed list D = [false] is strictly weaker (RT-05).

nodes.title: Simplified-Model WDPWorld / HWorld Guarded Commutation at Zero Admission/Retention Cost (OQ-08)
nodes.statement: DERIVED_CONDITIONALLY: Shows in Lean exact commutation between two simplified models (WDPWorld and HWorld via stepWDPWorld/stepHWorld in oq08_refinement_commutes_at_zero_adm_ret_cost and stepWDPWorldGuarded/stepHWorldGuarded in rt12_guarded_refinement_commutes_at_zero_adm_ret_cost) at cSup = 0, cAdm = 0, cRet = 0, cEv = 1, where stepHWorldGuarded checks 1 <= w.budget and carrier index v < w.toks.length. This simplified model omits three augmentation guards present in pinned legacy Represented.World (19L57G1/Represented.lean:105-120): view novelty !(decide (c in w.views)), strict separation increase increaseB w c, and augmentation licensing w.augLicensed. Concrete discrepancy regressions and adapted FullWDPWorld commutation are recorded in DER-19; the full source-level bridge from prose WDP-CH01-D03 to legacy Represented/Horizon remains open in OWE-12.

nodes.title: F2 vs Z Triangle/Tetrahedron Coboundary d^2 = 0, Orientation Intertwiner, and Vortex Defect (OQ-02 / RT-04)
nodes.statement: On a 3-cycle and 4-simplex (tetrahedron), unsigned incidence satisfies d^2 = 0 over F2 but fails over Z; signed orientation satisfies d1 o d0 = 0 and d2 o d1 = 0 over Z; cyclic edge orientation intertwines with simplicial boundary signs via diag(1, 1, -1); the unit vortex 1-cochain has non-zero curl d1(w_vortex) = 1 and minimum L1 coboundary defect >= 1.

nodes.title: Edge-Transitive vs Non-Transitive Positive L1 Weight Forcing (OQ-07 / RT-11)
nodes.statement: Positive edge weights w_i > 0 on the 3-cycle are forced equal (w1 = w2 = w3) under cyclic edge-transitive symmetry, whereas without symmetry or under a non-transitive involution swapping only edges 2 and 3, unequal positive weights (w1 = 1, w2 = w3 = 2) remain invariant and tilt minimum-cost repair toward edge 1.

nodes.title: Off-Diagonal Fixed-Pair Criterion for Natural Sections and Twisted Holonomy Obstruction (RT-07 / RT-08)
nodes.statement: A natural section sec : Unit -> alpha x alpha of AdmissiblePair obs under endomorphism sigma exists iff sigma fixes both components of an admissible pair; on Bool with obs = id and sigma = counterpart, raw admissible selection (false, true) exists while naturality is obstructed, and on Fin 3 a single fixed carrier point 0 under swap3 is insufficient (N17 / RT-07); on a 3-locus Bool triangle, untwisted transports glue uniquely while twisted transports are pairwise solvable with no global section (N18 / RT-08); faithful network descent forces trivial loop holonomy (RT-06).

nodes.title: Six-Guard Constitutional Self-Description, Behavioral Initiality, and Conservative Retract
nodes.statement: Operational support supp determines single-step and multi-step replay; the 6-boolean descriptor kernelDesc executes under the family interpreter interpStep to the exact sealed step function (interp_describe); across all 64 descriptors in allDescs, kernelDesc is the unique descriptor passing all six behavioral probes (dedupAdmit, guardRequire, guardAccept, gateBudget, gateLicense, certRefusal), each guard has an independent countermodel failing only its dedicated probe, and the panel-extended kernel CWorld retracts conservatively to World on base events.

nodes.title: Effectual-Outside Dichotomy, Panel Equivalence, and Interpreter Diagonal Non-Exhaustion
nodes.statement: Worlds agreeing on operational support replay to identical support and identical violation/quiescence verdicts, whereas panel re-entry grows the represented view store by the re-entered panel size (effectual_outside_dichotomy); panel signature agreement is an equivalence relation; no internal evaluator eval : Code -> Code -> Bool represents its own diagonal negation diagNeg, and for any finite code list cs : List C and evaluator ev : C -> World -> Event -> World, diagEvent cs ev differs from every c in cs at (genesis, note 0), while Option ConstitutionDesc provides a typed refusal extension evalOpt.

nodes.title: Monotonic Cumulative Measure and Strict No-Return Law
nodes.statement: Any append-only transition that strictly increases the cumulative regime measure mu(R) = |items| + |forms| + |insts| is irreflexive and asymmetric, preventing return to any prior regime state along non-empty positive-step chains.

nodes.title: Minimal Chain Audit, OQ-08 Guard Discrepancy Regressions, and Adapted 5-Gate Commutation (OQ-01 to OQ-08, RT-01 to RT-12)
nodes.statement: Audit check suites and Lean 4.33.0 regressions across OQ-01 through OQ-08 and RT-01 through RT-12, including four concrete OQ-08 guard-discrepancy regressions between simplified stepHWorldGuarded and pinned legacy Represented.World (singleton non-separating view addView [0] on data=[0], duplicate view rejection, disabled augmentation license rejection, and novel view with zero new separation rejection) and adapted 5-gate FullWDPWorld commutation with Represented.step at zero admission/retention cost. OQ-05 is discharged in DER-08 and DER-24 (formerly OWE-11), while OQ-08 remains DERIVED_CONDITIONALLY in DER-12 with its unconstructed source bridge tracked in OWE-12.

nodes.title: Profile-Equality vs. Mutual-Comparability Preorder and Quotient Retention Bridge (N19)
nodes.statement: On any carrier alpha and binary relation E : alpha -> alpha -> Prop, complete incoming+outgoing profile equality ProfileEquiv E is an equivalence relation, and mutual comparability MutualComp E is an equivalence relation whenever IsPreorder E holds. For any preorder E, ProfileEquiv E x y <-> MutualComp E x y (profileEquiv_iff_mutualComp_of_preorder), and for any equivalence relation E, ProfileEquiv E x y <-> E x y (profileEquiv_iff_rel_of_equivalence), while D2 on Bool shows that ProfileEquiv strictly generalizes MutualComp without reflexivity (profileEquiv_strictly_generalizes_mutualComp_without_refl) and boolLeq shows that directed non-relation does not coincide with class inequality (directed_not_rel_ne_class_ineq_on_preorder). For any RelationRefinement fine coarse, collapseMap is surjective (collapseMap_surjective) and injective iff reverse refinement holds (collapseMap_injective_iff_reverse_refinement), retaining distinct fine classes and fine nonzero Kernel defects inside coarse zero classes (failed_identification_retains_two_classes, symmetry_failure_retains_multiplicity, coarse_zero_coexists_with_fine_nonzero).

nodes.title: Conditional Ten-Stick Reflection Residual and Four-Step vs. Two-Step Phase Lift Models (N19-N20)
nodes.statement: DERIVED_CONDITIONALLY: Under the supplied 10-slot carrier Stick10 = Fin 10 -> Bool, spatial index reversal reflectIndex10(i) = 9 - i, configuration reversal reflect10, Hamming distance hamming10, and reflection-quotient residual reflResidual10(s, t) = min(hamming10 s t, hamming10 s (reflect10 t)), the 1-stick indicator configurations stickLeft (i = 0) and stickRight (i = 9) satisfy reflect10 stickLeft = stickRight, raw Hamming distance 2, and reflection residual 0 (stickLeft_stickRight_raw_vs_reflResidual), whereas stickLeft and stickMid (i = 1) have positive reflection residual 2 (stickLeft_stickMid_reflResidual_pos). Under the supplied 4-state carrier Fin 4 with cyclic step4 and parity readout proj2 : Fin 4 -> Bool, proj2 intertwines step4 with counterpart (proj2_intertwines_counterpart), step4 has exact period 4 (step4_period_four), and two steps project to identity on Bool while flipping the hidden sheet (step4_two_projects_to_id_but_flips_sheet); however, trivial_two_step_lift_also_intertwines shows on Bool x Bool via step4Triv that a 2-step lift also intertwines counterpart. Together with the exact two-sheet holonomy characterization and minimal n = 3 1-stick threshold in DER-25, endogenous forcing of non-trivial sheet-flip holonomy over trivial holonomy and the unforced choice of carrier size 10 over minimal n = 3 remain open in OWE-08.

nodes.title: Conditional Supplied-Rule Generator Growth, Lower Bound, and Radius-d Profile Collision (N21-N22)
nodes.statement: DERIVED_CONDITIONALLY: Under the externally supplied two-constructor item type MItem (tok vs. receipt in MState), supplied transition rules stepM and stepRefl on PState, and external Nat-indexed iteration reflState, shows in Lean: (1) a 2-step closure witness min_witnessed_route_closes paired with the lower-bound theorem stepM_lower_bound_two_steps over all stepM traces from empty state ⟨[], []⟩ measured by step count; and (2) linear growth of reflState n (n + 1 elements List.range (n + 1), n successor edges (k, k + 1), and n tags at round n in reflective_chain_growth, reflective_chain_is_initial_segment, reflective_chain_successor_relation), depth-1 and radius-d profile collisions for interior vertices when 1 + d <= i < j <= n - 1 - d (depth1_obstructions_are_exactly_middle_pairs, depth_d_obstruction, profileD_deep), and outrunning of any finite valued mark set (finite_marks_outrun, depth_d_outrun). Together with the exact radius-d separation threshold (n <= 2 * d + 2), endogenous tag-count adaptive horizon (adaptiveRadius), and 2^k binary memory capacity lower bound in DER-26, endogenous acquisition/invocation of the witnessing rule remains open in OWE-07 and endogenous non-supplied rule acquisition/repair without external PState structure remains open in OWE-13.

nodes.title: General Regime4 Transition-to-Class-Count Growth Bridge and Fresh-Unary Refinement Bound (OQ-05 / RT-09)
nodes.statement: Discharges the general Regime4 transition-to-class-count growth bridge (formerly OWE-11) in Lean 4.33.0 across all five components: (1) finite-carrier context enumeration (allSlotOptions4, allSlotLists4, allWfCtxs4, mem_allWfCtxs4_iff) and constructive boolean equivalence collapsed4Bool (collapsed4_iff_collapsed4Bool, separable4_iff_collapsed4Bool_false); (2) canonical least-element class representative counting on {0, ..., n - 1} (hasEarlierEquiv4, isRep4, classCount4, regimeClassCount4, classCount4_strict_mono_of_witness); (3) constructive canonical representative extraction (BoolEquivOn4, exists_rep_of_equiv4, StrictRefinementOn4, exists_new_rep_of_strictRefinementOn4, strict_refinement_classCount4_inc); (4) general StrictRegimeTransition4 class-count growth (regime4_strict_class_count_growth) and concrete fresh-unary form transitions (freshUnaryDelta4, stepFreshUnary4, applyDelta4_freshUnaryDelta4, stepFreshUnary4_strict_transition, stepFreshUnary4_class_count_growth); and (5) functorial bridge from m-step RegimeRefinementRun4 sequences to QuotRefRun (regimeRefinementRun4_to_quotRefRun, regimeRefinementRun4_round_bound m <= r.data - 1) and the RT-09 class-count comparison (rt09_class_count_comparison).

nodes.title: Exact Period-4 Two-Sheet Holonomy Characterization and Minimal n = 3 Reflection-Residual Carrier Threshold (N19-N20)
nodes.statement: For any base-intertwining lift step : Bool x Bool -> Bool x Bool satisfying IntertwinesCounterpart step ((step s).1 = counterpart s.1), two steps restore the visible base coordinate (two_step_base_returns_of_intertwines), odd steps have no fixed points (odd_steps_not_fixed_of_intertwines), and the 2-step map at every state s either fixes s or flips the hidden sheet to (s.1, counterpart s.2) (two_step_fiber_holonomy_dichotomy). Consequently, step has period 2 everywhere iff its 2-step sheet holonomy is trivial everywhere (period_two_iff_trivial_sheet_holonomy), and step has exact period 4 everywhere iff it has no 2-step fixed points (period_four_iff_no_two_step_fixed_point) iff its 2-step fiber holonomy flips the hidden sheet everywhere (period_four_iff_sheet_flip_holonomy, no_two_step_fixed_iff_sheet_flip_holonomy). The canonical sheet-coupled lift step4Sheet satisfies sheet-flip holonomy and period 4 (step4Sheet_has_sheet_flip_holonomy_and_period_four) and is equivariantly isomorphic to (Fin 4, step4, proj2) via fin4ToSheet and sheetToFin4 (fin4_sheet_equivariant_bijection). For n-slot binary stick reflection (N19), n = 1 has reflResidual1 = hamming1 with no mirror collapse (n1_reflResidual_eq_hamming), n = 2 exhibits 1-stick mirror collapse (hamming2 = 2, reflResidual2 = 0) but zero reflection residual on all 1-stick pairs (n2_single_sticks_mirror_collapse_but_zero_residual), and n = 3 (Stick3) is the minimal carrier threshold where 1-stick configurations simultaneously exhibit mirror collapse (reflResidual3 stick3Left stick3Right = 0 at hamming3 = 2) and positive reflection residual (reflResidual3 stick3Left stick3Mid = 2 at hamming3 = 2, n3_minimal_single_stick_reflection_witness).

nodes.title: Exact Radius-d Separation Threshold, Endogenous Tag-Count Adaptive Horizon, and 2^k Memory Capacity Scaling (N22)
nodes.statement: Along the reflective chain reflState n on {0, ..., n}, the bidirectional radius-d endpoint-distance profile graphProfileD n i d = (backwardHit i d, forwardHit n i d) exhibits deep-interior collision at d + 1 != d + 2 whenever n >= 2 * d + 3 (graphProfileD_obstruction_of_ge) and is injective on {0, ..., n} whenever n <= 2 * d + 2 (graphProfileD_inj_of_le), yielding the exact iff threshold graphProfileD_separates_all_iff (separation of all pairs i, j <= n holds iff n <= 2 * d + 2). Reading the internal tag store length directly via adaptiveRadius s = s.tags.length / 2 without external round parameters satisfies n <= 2 * adaptiveRadius (reflState n) + 2 (adaptiveRadius_reflState_bound) and retains full pairwise separation at every round n (adaptive_radius_retains_full_separation_all_rounds). For general multi-round binary history retention, the constructive finite pigeonhole theorem (compressBelow, pigeonhole_inj_le) establishes that any encoder separating all 2^k histories of length k within a memory carrier of size mCard requires 2^k <= mCard (multi_round_memory_capacity_lower_bound), with mandatory collision whenever mCard < 2^k (multi_round_memory_collision_of_lt_pow2).

nodes.title: Orbit-Decomposed Automorphism-Invariant L1 Cochain Weights on 3-Edge and General n-Edge Cochains (OQ-07 / RT-11)
nodes.statement: On 3-edge cochains with validRepair (v1 + v2 + v3 = 1), invariance of weightedL1 w under swapEdge23 holds iff w.2.1 = w.2.2 (swap23_invariant_iff_orbit_constant), decomposing the L1 cost into two independent orbit weights w.1 * |v1| + w.2.1 * (|v2| + |v3|) (swap23_invariant_cost_decomposition); invariance under swapEdge12 holds iff w.1 = w.2.1 (swap12_invariant_iff_orbit_constant); and the three-regime symmetry hierarchy (three_edge_symmetry_weight_hierarchy) shows that 1-generator involutions leave a 2-parameter orbit family while joint swapEdge12 and swapEdge23 invariance (generating S3) forces w.1 = w.2.1 = w.2.2. On general n-edge cochains, evaluating weightedL1Gen w on the Kronecker delta unitCochain e extracts w e for e < n (weightedL1Gen_unitCochain_Zero_of_ge, weightedL1Gen_unitCochain), so unit-cochain invariance under any edge map sigma : Nat -> Nat preserving {0, ..., n - 1} forces step constancy w (sigma e) = w e (symmetry_forces_step_equal_weights_general) and constancy across every sigma-orbit w (iterEdge sigma k e) = w e (symmetry_forces_orbit_equal_weights_general). Whenever w is uniform (w e = w0 for e < n), weightedL1Gen w v n factors as w0 * unweightedL1Gen v n (uniform_weights_factor_l1_general), and any action transitive from 0 forces w e = w 0 for all e < n together with global L1 factoring (transitive_action_forces_uniform_weights_general).

nodes.title: Pre-Genesis Diamond-to-Root Bridge Obligation
nodes.statement: In the historical pre-Genesis narrative, the transition from pre-structural diamond/void language to an inhabited off-diagonal root witness is not forced by pure logic; it remains an explicit owed bridge (or must be replaced by explicit admission S1).

nodes.title: Genesis-to-Window Multiplicity and Finite Carrier Selection Bridge
nodes.statement: Moving from the sealed 2-position mark S2Bool to a finite multi-element window Fin n (n >= 3) requires an explicit multiplicity admission (M1) or iterated product construction (M2/M3) rather than emerging from S2Bool alone.

nodes.title: Operational Internal Witness Acquisition and Endogenous Rule Invocation (N21)
nodes.statement: OWED: While DER-23 checks deterministic trace growth and radius-d profile collisions under the externally supplied rules stepM and stepRefl, iterating a supplied rule that appends a fresh element, tag, and edge on invocation does not derive how a purely internal system acquires or invokes that constructor without an external caller, nor does a profile collision under a chosen observation map constitute performed internal witnessing. Discharging this obligation requires deriving endogenous witness acquisition and invocation without presupposing the MItem (tok vs. receipt) constructor split or external step scheduling.

nodes.title: Endogenous Sheet-Flip Holonomy Forcing and Ten-Stick Carrier Selection Beyond Minimal n = 3 (N19-N20)
nodes.statement: OWED: While DER-21 checks the general profile-equality vs. mutual-comparability preorder theorem (ProfileEquiv vs. MutualComp), DER-22 checks ten-stick reflection residuality (Stick10) and the 4-state cycle lift (Fin 4 vs. step4Triv), and DER-25 establishes the exact iff characterization of period-4 lifts on Bool x Bool via 2-step sheet-flip holonomy (period_four_iff_sheet_flip_holonomy) together with the minimal n = 3 carrier threshold for 1-stick reflection residuality (n3_minimal_single_stick_reflection_witness vs. n = 1, 2), reciprocal symmetry on Bool alone admits both trivial 2-step holonomy (step4Triv, period 2) and non-trivial sheet-flip holonomy (step4Sheet, period 4). Thus endogenous forcing of non-trivial 2-step sheet-flip holonomy over trivial holonomy and any forcing of carrier size n = 10 over the minimal n = 3 threshold remain open.

nodes.title: Cross-Orbit Positive Cochain Weight Ratio Selection on Non-Transitive Quotients (OQ-07 / RT-11)
nodes.statement: OWED: While DER-14 checks 3-edge cyclic symmetry vs. swapEdge23 and DER-27 establishes both the 3-edge symmetry hierarchy (swap23_invariant_iff_orbit_constant, swap23_invariant_cost_decomposition, three_edge_symmetry_weight_hierarchy) and general n-edge orbit constancy and transitive uniformity (symmetry_forces_orbit_equal_weights_general, transitive_action_forces_uniform_weights_general), automorphism invariance forces weights to be constant on each edge orbit without fixing the ratio between distinct orbits when the automorphism group has two or more edge orbits. Selecting a canonical cross-orbit weight ratio on non-edge-transitive quotient graphs without an external pricing admission remains open.

nodes.title: Profile Preorder, Unconditional Closure, and Continuum Completeness Bridge (N23, N25, N26)
nodes.statement: The historical profile preorder / unconditional closure claims (N23, N25, N26) and any downstream continuum real completeness require explicit ordering, closure-policy, or infinite completion admissions beyond finite counting and rational defect ratios.

nodes.statement: OWED: While DER-12 shows in Lean commutation between simplified models (WDPWorld and HWorld) and DER-19 shows both the 4 concrete guard-discrepancy regressions and commutation for the adapted 5-gate FullWDPWorld model, the prose ledger specification WDP-CH01-D03 in theory_of_finite_quantum_mechanics (witnessed_difference_programme.md:513-530, commit e45ed2e133920aa3790af8c5e072ee9829898490) does not define data-subset views, view novelty, increaseB separation checks, or augLicensed gating from 19L57G1/Represented.lean and Horizon.lean (commit 45bb09864f9b52ed5ecf66e977ca81f0ed623de7). nodes.title: Discrete Action Variational Principle, Noether Conservation, and Canonical Pairs

nodes.title: Finite Lattice Gauge Theory: U(1) QED, SU(2)xU(1) Electroweak, and SU(3) Color
nodes.statement: Extend C2 link holonomy on simplicial 2-complexes to non-abelian gauge groupoids, Wilson plaquette actions, discrete Gauss law constraints, and anomaly cancellation checks.

nodes.title: Simplicial 3D/4D Regge-Barbero-Immirzi Curvature and Discrete Einstein-Hilbert Action
nodes.statement: Couple simplicial 2-face deficit angles and edge-length assignments on 3D/4D triangulations to form a discrete Regge action with exact Bianchi identity conservation on dual cells.

nodes.title: Finite Constructor Theory, Irreversibility, and Landauer Erasure Cost
nodes.statement: Connect the 16/1024 memory retention laws, merger erasure (merger_erases), and strict measure monotonicity (strict_measure_no_return) to finite constructor tasks, admissible vs obstructed transformations, and thermodynamic erasure bounds.

nodes.title: Self-Hosting Cosmos Internal Mathematics, Proof Checker, and Reflective Closure
nodes.statement: Extend the internal metatheory slice (InternalMetatheory.lean) into a self-hosting finite syntax, type checker, and reflective stage compiler capable of internalizing each stage of the derivation DAG along the diagonal tower.
